_meta.adr: ADR-037 modular manifest fragment — never edit src/manifest.json
_meta.description: Reporting & Compliance consolidation: two custom pages under the existing top-level 'Compliance' group (label 'Reporting & Compliance', defined in the base manifest). The overview page renders the static ReportCatalogue as category-grouped cards with a per-card format picker + a Generate dialog that POSTs /api/reporting/generate; the generated-reports index lists the persisted GeneratedReport records with a download link. Both are type=custom (kind:page in src/registry.js) because neither the category-grouped card grid + generate dialog nor the download-link cell + three-facet filter row fits a built-in dashboard/index page type (ADR-024 / ADR-036). The menu leaves are merged into the existing 'Compliance' group by id (per mergeMenuItems in main.js); the stranded report leaves scattered across Belastingen / Bookkeeping / PublicSector / Purchasing are re-homed into this same group via src/menu-layout.json#relocations.
